LESSON: WRITING 1.3.1 PRINT AWARENESS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Writing 1.3.1 Print awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 1.3.1 Print awareness, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: What do you use when drawing pictures? 2. What do you like drawing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 1.3.1 Print awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: observation skills as learner keenly observes peers sign singing a song related to familiar

things in the environment.

• Creativity and imagination: experimenting skill as learner experiments with ideas on holding pencils, pens, sticks or coloring

pencils correctly and scribble freely on surfaces.

Values:
• Responsibility: determination as learner scribbles on books and color pictures without assistance.

• Peace: love as learner shares scribbling and coloring materials such as pencils and crayons without scrambling.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Hygiene under health related issues as the learner washes hands with soap and clean water after a modelling learning experience.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The modelling of familiar things in the environment relate to modeling experiences in Creative Arts.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Assistive devices fitted with appropriate technology such as hearing aids and amplifiers, Pencils, pens, sticks, coloring pencils,

pictures, signed video, pre recorded signed songs, books, online resources, relevant digital devices.
